codeReview.summary: The feature intent is met: commit f6f913c adds a scripted post-login capture path, produces Fedora/Oracle evidence artifacts with explicit `systemctl --failed --no-pager` output (both exit code 0, no failed units), and links those results from the main amd64 boot validation report.

issues.description: The summary heredoc hard-codes `Source Docker Image` tags (`kairos-init:fedora43-amd64-boot-20260324222755` and `kairos-init:oracle10-amd64-boot-20260324223401`), which can become stale on reruns and weaken the 'current-run artifact linkage' claim.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Feature metadata requires `skillName: validation-worker`, but the repository skill directory has no reviewable skill document, so procedure compliance cannot be checked against a source-of-truth skill file.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: features.json entry for `amd64-boot-postlogin-healthcheck-evidence` sets `skillName` to `validation-worker`; `/home/sandbox/kairos-init/.factory/skills/validation-worker/` is empty (no `SKILL.md`).

sharedStateObservations.observation: Mission shared-state guidance appears stale about QEMU availability.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Mission AGENTS.md line 36 says host QEMU binaries are unavailable, but this feature transcript and commit f6f913c show successful use of `/usr/libexec/qemu-kvm` for Fedora and Oracle post-login capture.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Expected shared service inventory file is missing from repo-level `.factory` state.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: No `.factory/services.yaml` present under `/home/sandbox/kairos-init` (glob `**/services.yaml` returned no matches), while worker transcript includes a lookup for that path.

summary: Review PASS for amd64-boot-postlogin-healthcheck-evidence. Implementation satisfies the feature behavior with explicit Fedora/Oracle post-login `systemctl --failed --no-pager` evidence and updated assertion mapping; one non-blocking robustness issue was noted plus shared-state documentation gaps.
